title: Standards for Streets and Blocks

blocks.html: Developments or enlargements that result in a total of at least 100,000 square feet of floor area on individual zoning lots of at least 200,000 square feet or groups of zoning lots subject to the provisions of Section 124-60 (SPECIAL PERMIT TO MODIFY USE OR BULK REGULATIONS) that are, in aggregate, at least 200,000 square feet, shall front upon streets that comply with the requirements of this Section, inclusive, unless modified by special permit pursuant to Section 124-60.
blocks.plainText: Developments or enlargements that result in a total of at least 100,000 square feet of floor area on individual zoning lots of at least 200,000 square feet or groups of zoning lots subject to the provisions of Section 124-60 (SPECIAL PERMIT TO MODIFY USE OR BULK REGULATIONS) that are, in aggregate, at least 200,000 square feet, shall front upon streets that comply with the requirements of this Section, inclusive, unless modified by special permit pursuant to Section 124-60.

amendmentHistory.notes: Added special permit applicability language distinguishing single zoning lots of at least 200,000 sf from groups of zoning lots of at least 200,000 sf.
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying provisions of Article XII, Chapter 4 (Special Willets Point District)
